$comment: Provenance manifest for zone GeoJSON layers. Update fetched_on, vintage, and caveats each time a layer is refreshed. Generated 2026-05-21 from audit-2026-05-21-*.md.

layers.label: TIF Districts
layers.sourceAgency: City of Chicago — Department of Planning and Development
layers.caveats: Currently 100 features in file; current active count is 124 (Civic Federation, 2025). 9 districts expired 12/31/2025; 13 more expire 12/31/2026. Refresh required.

layers.label: Special Service Areas
layers.caveats: 58 features; matches current citywide SSA count.

layers.label: Illinois Enterprise Zones
layers.sourceAgency: Illinois DCEO + City of Chicago EZ Administrator
layers.caveats: 6 polygons (Chicago EZ I-VI). All expire 2030; recertification window opens 2028.

layers.label: Federal Opportunity Zones
layers.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of the Treasury / IRS
layers.caveats: 181 features. Valid through 12/31/2028. OBBBA (July 2025) made OZ permanent on decennial cycle; OZ 2.0 tracts certified by Treasury late 2026, effective 1/1/2027 — refresh required then.

layers.label: Illinois Opportunity Zones
layers.caveats: 24 features in current file — appears to be a Chicago subset, not the full ~327 IL OZ tracts. Verify scope. Illinois must nominate ~238 new tracts in H2 2026 effective 1/1/2027.

layers.label: HUD Qualified Census Tracts
layers.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
layers.caveats: 418 features. HUD publishes new QCT designations annually each January 1. 2026 designations effective 1/1/2026 use 2020 census tract boundaries — refresh from HUD Open Data.

layers.label: NMTC Eligible Census Tracts
layers.caveats: 695 features. Re-baselines with each 5-year ACS release. Refresh when 2019-2023 ACS NMTC eligibility lookup is published by CDFI Fund (expected mid-2026). Program made permanent by OBBBA (July 2025).

layers.label: State Incentive Zones (EDGE / REV / MICRO / Data Center proxy)
layers.caveats: Proxy boundary — REV / EDGE / MICRO / Data Center programs are project-by-project, not zone-based. The 114-feature high-unemployment census-tract overlay is used as an approximation for the 'underserved area' enhanced-credit eligibility. Same file is referenced by edge-zones, rev-zones, micro-zones, data-center-zones.

layers.label: CCSA Commercial Corridors
layers.caveats: 12 features. Matches current CCSA program scope.

layers.label: Industrial Corridors
layers.caveats: 26 features. Armitage modernization complete 2025; Burnside and Calumet modernization plans in progress — verify geometry on next refresh.

layers.label: Micro Market Recovery Areas
layers.sourceAgency: City of Chicago — Department of Housing
layers.caveats: 13 features; current MMRP area count is 19 per chicago.gov/doh. Refresh required. Note program moved from DPD to DOH and is now homeownership-focused.

layers.label: Neighborhood Opportunity Fund Eligible and Priority Corridors
layers.sourceAgency: City of Chicago — DPD / SomerCor NOF lookup app
layers.scope: NOF eligible and priority commercial corridors inside the Qualified Investment Area
layers.caveats: Combined NOF Eligible Corridors and NOF Priority Corridors from the official lookup map. This is a first-pass location screen; DPD/SomerCor make final eligibility determinations.

layers.label: High Unemployment Census Tracts
layers.sourceAgency: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics + IRS WOTC tract designation
layers.caveats: Information overlay only — WOTC authority lapsed 12/31/2025 and is awaiting reauthorization.

layers.label: Chicago Landmark Districts
layers.sourceAgency: City of Chicago — Commission on Chicago Landmarks (DPD-HP)
layers.caveats: 59 features; current count is 62 per 2025 Landmarks Ordinance. Refresh from data.cityofchicago.org.

layers.label: National Register Historic Districts
layers.caveats: No statutory changes 2025-2026. New listings added periodically by NPS.

layers.label: SBIF Past Projects
layers.caveats: Informational overlay only — eligibility is governed by active TIF district membership, not by this point layer.

layers.label: REV Illinois Zones (proxy)
layers.caveats: Same proxy as stateIncentiveZones. REV is project-by-project.

layers.label: EDGE Underserved Areas (proxy)
layers.caveats: Same proxy as stateIncentiveZones. EDGE underserved-area boost approximated by high-unemployment overlay.

layers.label: MICRO Underserved Areas (proxy)
layers.caveats: Same proxy as stateIncentiveZones. MICRO underserved-area boost approximated by high-unemployment overlay.

layers.label: Data Center Underserved Areas (proxy)
layers.caveats: Same proxy as stateIncentiveZones. Note: Pritzker announced a 2-year moratorium on new Data Center certifications effective 7/1/2026.

layers.label: Triple-Benefit Zones (informational)
layers.caveats: Computed overlay highlighting areas where ≥3 incentive zones overlap. Regenerate when underlying layers refresh.

layers.label: Cook County Class 8 Townships
layers.scope: Bloom, Bremen, Calumet, Rich, Thornton townships
layers.caveats: Layer file not yet built. Source: Cook Central / ChicagoCityscape/pins GitHub. Pipeline: shapefile → filter → convert-shapefiles.mjs → register in lib/constants.ts.
